goal.statement: A directly usable read-only efficiency observation module: pure analysis API, bounded loopback collect/analyze/report CLI, stable summary for the trial UI, and traceable sanitized reports.
goal.blockedPilot: E original 24turn/200000token/USD5 single-in-flight pilot remains BLOCKED; G did not reset, top up, refund, replace samples or research new pricing/recipes.
goal.authority: none — results are observations, not acceptance, routing, budget, release or execution authority

finalCommit: the commit that introduces this file (branch head codex/g4-usage-insights)

phases.result: usage-insights-input/1 + usage-insights/1 protocols, metric catalogue with unit/aggregation/definition, pure API; unavailable fields recorded explicitly
real shared schemas validate every record; identity dedupe, conflict quarantine, layer separation, window/scope refusal, per-record invalid isolation
queue/ready-to-acceptance/active-review/interventions/usage metrics; null+reason when unobserved; no zero filling; no price lookup
runnable read-only collect/analyze/report/verify/catalogue CLI with help, strict args, fixtures and JSON/terminal/Markdown output
bounded authenticated loopback GET adapter: explicit origin + credential file, redirect refusal, per-request timeout, overall deadline, page/work/byte caps, cursor validation
same real adapter for HTTP and verified-file input; same bytes yield the same summary id; recorded digest mismatch is refused; layers are never upgraded

operator baseline requires source/definition/project/window/timezone/metric/unit/aggregation/layer/samples/coverage; comparison is observational only, with zero-denominator/overlap/layer-mismatch refusals
collect → analyze → report chained on one observation window with truthful complete/partial/unavailable statuses in exit codes and stderr
toInsightConsumerView projects the stable summary into the trial workspace's compact view type; compile-time structural assertion; null stays null
reports document each metric, cite record-level provenance ids, list observed subjects, separate layers and escape untrusted text
exclusive 0600 create, refuse existing/symlink/symlinked parent/unwritable/out-of-space, no temporary leftovers, sanitized errors, token never persisted
stable package API + additive-only compatibility policy + fixtures + F integration sample; readiness/configuration snapshot is an appendix with authority none and changes no metric

two-project observation over the real product HTTP app with real store/application/attention/evidence readers; same-title works stay separate; reads create no product events; repeated collection is byte-identical
limits: data layer is controlled; no operator production instance was read

phases.result: bounded analysis (4500 outcomes across 3 layers), 1000 quarantined records with capped diagnostics, 300 identity conflicts, 30 currencies, declared caps enforced; no shared schema or dependency changes
operator documentation: commands, input protocol, loopback/credential rules, windows/timezone/limits, metric semantics, baseline rules, troubleshooting, privacy boundary
this status file: phases, four results, commands, exit codes, measured values, coverage, limits and not-reached items

exitCodes.3: partial: bounded/truncated source or quarantined records
exitCodes.4: insufficient data: source missing or not collected
exitCodes.5: source unavailable, digest mismatch or output not writable

observation.source: real product HTTP app on 127.0.0.1 with bearer authentication, private temporary state root

attention.meaning: current pending-age snapshot, not historical queue waiting

bounds.notes: in-process pure analysis; timings are a short bounded check, not a soak or a performance guarantee

consumer.compatibility: usage-insights/1 additive-only; null means unknown and is never defaulted to 0
mainIntegrationNeeded: root import/export wiring if the console consumes it directly

notReached: actual_native execution data: NOT_TESTED — no vendor/model/native turn was performed and no native sample was fabricated
operator production instance: NOT_ATTEMPTED — no operator credential was available; the tool supports it via --base-url/--token-file
real operator baseline: example baseline is illustrative only; no user-supplied baseline exists
queue.waitMs over real data: the current product read surface exposes no queued/dispatched endpoint pair
review timing over real data: the isolated probe had no candidate acceptance flow; semantics are covered by synthetic fixtures
human answers/acceptances in the probe: measured 0 with 2 observed works, not synthesized
long-running stability, cross-machine performance and 48h soak: out of scope
limitations: All numbers are observations of recorded facts. Nothing here proves saved hours, efficiency gains, causality or quality.
Interaction metrics are product-record counts; they carry no evidence layer and are not execution evidence.
review.activeMs is a partial UI-visibility proxy, never human working time.
Unknown usage and unknown cost stay unknown; prices are not looked up and currencies are never combined.
A bundle retains product record detail (for example work titles) and is a private 0600 input; only generated reports are sanitized for sharing.
Reporting on a production instance would require that instance's own credential; G does not discover or reuse credentials.
